metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in the United Kingdom increase in February 11-25, 2019 compared to the same period average from 2000-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A2 or MYD11A2) - 8-day composite - Date: Feb 11-25, 2019 vs Feb 11-25 average from 2000-2012 - Location: United Kingdom polygon 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has quality bands, should use quality control to mask poor quality pixels - Use LST_Day_1km band for daytime temperature 3. Logic: - Calculate mean LST for Feb 11-25, 2019 - Calculate mean LST for Feb 11-25 period averaged over 2000-2012 - Compare if 2019 > historical average - Need to handle potential data gaps and quality issues Important considerations: - MODIS LST scale is 1000m - Need to convert from Kelvin to Celsius (scale 0.02, offset -273.15) - Use quality band to filter out poor quality pixels - Check collection sizes and valid pixel counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const uk = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland')); const febPeriod2019 = ['2019-02-11', '2019-02-26']; const historicalPeriods = []; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2012; year++) { historicalPeriods.push([`${year}-02-11`, `${year}-02-26`]); } // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS LST const getLSTCollection = function(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(uk) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); }; // Function to process LST with quality masking const processLST = function(image) { const lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius const qc = image.select('QC_Day'); const qualityMask = qc.bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11', 2)).eq(0); // Good quality pixels return lst.updateMask(qualityMask); }; // Get 2019 data const lst2019Col = getLSTCollection(febPeriod2019[0], febPeriod2019[1]); const lst2019Size = lst2019Col.size().getInfo(); if (lst2019Size === 0) { console.log("2019 Images: 0"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get historical data const historicalCollections = historicalPeriods.map(period => getLSTCollection(period[0], period[1]) ); const historicalSizes = historicalCollections.map(col => col.size().getInfo()); const validHistorical = historicalSizes.filter(size => size > 0).length; if (validHistorical === 0) { console.log(`2019 Images: ${lst2019Size}, Historical: 0 valid years`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Process 2019 data const lst2019 = lst2019Col.map(processLST).mean(); // Process historical data const historicalMeans = historicalCollections .filter(col => col.size().getInfo() > 0) .map(col => col.map(processLST).mean()); const historicalComposite = ee.ImageCollection(historicalMeans).mean(); // Check pixel counts const count2019 = lst2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const countHistorical = historicalComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); if (count2019 === 0 || countHistorical === 0) { console.log(`2019 Pixels: ${count2019}, Historical Pixels: ${countHistorical}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate means const mean2019 = lst2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const meanHistorical = historicalComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); // Validation if (mean2019 === null || meanHistorical === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(meanHistorical) || Math.abs(mean2019) > 60 || Math.abs(meanHistorical) > 60) { // Sanity check for LST range console.log(`2019 Mean: ${mean2019}, Historical Mean: ${meanHistorical}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Final comparison console.log(`2019 Images: ${lst2019Size}, Historical Years: ${validHistorical}/13`); console.log(`2019 Temp: ${mean2019.toFixed(2)}°C, Historical: ${meanHistorical.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${(mean2019 - meanHistorical).toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`2019 Pixels: ${count2019}, Historical Pixels: ${countHistorical}`); if (mean2019 > meanHistorical) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
